scope.summary: Config-gated (default off) database-side READ ONLY transaction for metadata-pool reads at READ_ONLY level: rollback, SET TRANSACTION READ ONLY, read, rollback; a failed arm refuses and discards the connection; no leak to later pooled use, no auto-commit; guard unchanged.
out_of_scope: With the setting on, a metadata read of a table whose DDL is 1-2 s old gets ORA-01466 and the connection is discarded (opt-in strictness; follow-up bead filed).
Changed by these commits but excluded from the clean-scope binding because later landings modified them: scripts/e2e/w4/driver.py, tests/artifacts/evidence/metadata-read-only-pool-reachability.json
